purpose: Skip-and-fill 50-record batch 107 from the clean 561-record reference-dependent queue. Twenty-four safe candidates were carried forward after a concurrent batch 106 claimed overlapping records; twenty-six additional records were selected from the fresh post-106 artifact. The batch avoids truncated sources, unresolved cross-edition inheritance, table-driven records, and summon/stat-block-heavy candidates.

spells/rejuvenating-light-599.name: Rejuvenating Light
spells/rejuvenating-light-599.effectSummary: For 1 minute per caster level, the touched object shines as daylight. Living creatures in the 60-foot bright-light radius gain fast healing 1 while inside it. Undead in the bright light take 1d6 positive-energy damage each round, or 2d6 if especially vulnerable to sunlight; a Fortitude save negates that round's damage and spell resistance applies. It counters and dispels darkness spells of equal or lower level.
spells/rejuvenating-light-599.notes: Self-contained 3.5-era effect; the daylight comparison only defines illumination.

provenance.role: primary Complete Champion catalog record and digest source

spells/harm-2741.name: Harm
spells/harm-2741.effectSummary: On a touch, deals 10 points of negative-energy damage per caster level, maximum 150. A successful Will save halves the damage, and on a successful save the spell cannot reduce the target below 1 hp. Against undead, it instead functions as heal.

provenance.role: primary Player's Handbook v.3.5 catalog record and digest source
